title_en: Opinions of the People's Courts on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor by the People's Courts

Fa Fa [2025] No. 6

In order to fully implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee on promoting the high-quality construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, and to improve the ability and level of judicial services and safeguards for the construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, the following opinions are formulated in light of the actual work of the People's Courts.

I. Effectively Enhance the Sense of Responsibility and Mission for Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for the Construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor

1. Raise political awareness. Accelerating the construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor is a major strategic deployment made by the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core. The People's Courts must stand at a strategic height of promoting high-quality development and high-level opening up, and deeply understand the significant significance of accelerating the construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor in forming a new pattern for the large-scale development of the western region, connecting with the high-quality joint construction of the "Belt and Road," and accelerating the formation of a comprehensive opening-up pattern of "interconnected land-sea and east-west mutual assistance." They shall closely focus on the central work of the Party and the state to perform their duties, accurately grasp the new international and domestic situations and changes, and the new tasks and requirements for regional coordinated development, assist in creating a stable, transparent, standardized, and predictable rule of law environment, and provide a solid legal guarantee for the construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor.

2. Clarify duties and positioning. Based on the duty of judicial adjudication, serve the implementation of major national strategies in accordance with the law, precisely meet the judicial needs of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor construction, coordinate the existing judicial cooperation mechanisms along the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, gather judicial synergy, and legally serve and ensure the efficient connection of the rail-sea intermodal trains of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor with the China-Europe Railway Express and the Yangtze River Golden Waterway. Improve civil and commercial dispute resolution mechanisms involving pilot free trade zones, land port economic zones, airport economic zones, border economic cooperation zones, and international cooperation parks, and perfect the rules for the application of law. Lawfully resolve various disputes involving transportation corridor construction, transportation station construction, logistics distribution services, logistics industry financing, trade and investment cooperation, data rights protection, etc., and promote the comprehensive construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor with stronger transport capacity, more reasonable hub layout, and more convenient multimodal transport.

II. Fully Leverage the Role of Judicial Services in Infrastructure "Hard Connectivity" and Rule and Mechanism "Soft Connectivity"

3. Effectively resolve disputes and stop conflicts. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving transportation corridor construction, logistics facility construction, port and shipping facility construction, and cross-border port construction, to promote the construction of high-capacity main corridors and the connection of international transport corridors. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving logistics enterprise transport, financing, equity transfer, etc., to promote logistics enterprises to optimize their asset structure and governance structure. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving rail-sea intermodal transport, road-rail-water intermodal transport, international aviation, international shipping, cross-border trains and buses, etc., to promote the healthy development of the supply chain along the New Western Land-Sea Corridor. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving offshore trade, cross-border e-commerce, border trade, etc., to ensure the smooth and efficient flow of goods. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving loans, securities, futures transactions, and negotiable instruments related to the construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, to regulate the order of investment and financing in capital markets along the corridor. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving data rights and intellectual property rights, to promote the deep integration of the digital economy and the real economy. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving environmental pollution prevention and control, ecological protection, and climate change response, to promote the construction of green infrastructure and the development of green logistics for the New Western Land-Sea Corridor.

4. Improve adjudication rules. Focus on the legal application issues arising from the electronic use of documents in single-mode transport, multimodal transport, warehousing, etc., play the role of the judiciary in promoting the improvement of rules for electronic transferable records, extract and summarize adjudication rules for international transport documents such as international railway waybills and the multimodal transport "single document system," and unify adjudication standards. Further improve the judicial trial system for parties' agreement on jurisdiction and selection of applicable law in civil relationships involving foreign elements, and equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties. Timely study and formulate judicial interpretations or judicial policies on the adjudication of transport contract disputes, promote the coordination and unification of international rules for cross-border transport, and assist the New Western Land-Sea Corridor in playing an important role as a link for the smooth functioning of dual circulation.

III. Continuously Optimize the Institutional Mechanisms for Judicial Services for the Integration of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor Construction and Regional Economic Development

5. Optimize the jurisdiction system. Study the construction of a comprehensive transport jurisdiction system that conforms to the characteristics of large corridors and large logistics, play the synergistic role of specialized people's courts such as railway transport courts and maritime courts, and people's courts at all levels along the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, ensure the connection and coordination of various single-mode transport rules and multimodal transport rules, and gradually establish a jurisdiction mechanism matching the logistics transport disputes of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor. With the approval of the Supreme People's Court, the higher people's courts along the New Western Land-Sea Corridor may, based on the characteristics of trial work in their respective jurisdictions, promote the centralized jurisdiction of cases related to transportation logistics, cross-border transport, single-mode transport, multimodal transport, etc., within their jurisdictions, to improve the level of professionalization, quality, and efficiency of trials.

6. Promote litigation facilitation. Strengthen consultation and cooperation with judicial institutions of neighboring countries and regions of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, deeply promote litigation facilitation reforms for border trade disputes, explore a fast trial mechanism for border trade disputes, rapidly authenticate electronic evidence such as electronic transport records and cross-border payment vouchers, improve case handling efficiency, and assist the innovative development of border trade. Lawfully and timely take legal measures such as preservation of evidence and preservation of conduct, adopt flexible preservation measures for goods in transit and means of transport, and ensure the normal operation of enterprises. Improve the foreign-related service mechanism, and, under the premise of complying with the laws of relevant countries, promote the application of technologies such as electronic service of judicial documents, electronic evidence storage, and online authentication. With the approval of the Supreme People's Court, pilot higher people's courts in important hub and node cities of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor that meet the conditions may directly submit and forward requests for judicial assistance to foreign central authorities under the Hague Service Convention and the Hague Evidence Convention.

7. Improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism. Innovate and improve the international commercial trial mechanism and institutional construction, and continuously enhance the professional ability of international commercial trials. Establish and improve a one-stop diversified dispute resolution platform, relying on the comprehensive governance centers established along the New Western Land-Sea Corridor and the diversified dispute resolution mechanisms with regional and industrial characteristics, enhance docking with functional departments, arbitration institutions, mediation institutions, industry organizations, forensic appraisal institutions, notarization and certification institutions, etc., and build a regional international commercial diversified dispute resolution platform. Support enterprises registered within pilot free trade zones in agreeing to arbitrate relevant disputes at specific locations, in accordance with specific arbitration rules, and by specific persons. Support the recruitment of professionals from neighboring countries and regions as mediators, and support joint mediation by foreign mediators and domestic mediators.

IV. Promote the Formation of a Joint Force to Serve and Safeguard the Construction and Operation of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor

8. Strengthen investigation and research. Deeply study the property effect of transferable cargo documents under the "Belt and Road" initiative, and the cutting-edge judicial and legal issues involved in the formulation of standards for cross-border e-commerce, platform governance, electronic labels, cross-border data flow, cross-border supply chain finance, facilitation of cross-border RMB business, and integrated innovation of logistics finance and insurance. Strengthen research on legal issues concerning the operation of overseas economic and trade cooperation zones and the participation of Chinese enterprises in the construction and operation of overseas projects, and guide "going global" enterprises to prevent legal risks. Deeply promote the construction of digital courts, relying on the national "one network" of courts, promote the interconnection and sharing of judicial big data related to the construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, expand data consultation and analysis applications, and timely issue judicial suggestions to relevant units to jointly prevent legal risks.

9. Strengthen internal and external coordination and linkage. Strengthen work coordination with the provincial-ministerial joint conference system for the construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, and support the Chongqing High People's Court in taking the lead in establishing and improving the inter-provincial judicial cooperation mechanism for the New Western Land-Sea Corridor. Timely release typical cases and policy suggestions related to the construction of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, and recommend selected cases and research results to be included in the People's Courts Case Database and the selected Q&A of the Legal Answer Network. Strengthen the construction of a coordinated governance mechanism between financial judiciary and regulation along the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, and explore a joint mechanism for preventing and resolving financial risks along the New Western Land-Sea Corridor. Improve the mechanism for training judicial personnel and regional exchanges, support the innovative ways of collaborative talent cultivation by people's courts along the corridor, and realize the interconnection and integration of talent resources.

10. Deepen international exchanges and cooperation. Consolidate and expand channels for cooperation and exchange, make good use of open cooperation platforms such as the Meeting of Presidents of Supreme Courts of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization Member States, the China-ASEAN Justice Forum, and the Meeting of Presidents of Supreme Courts of China and Central Asian Countries, deepen regional judicial exchanges, strengthen practical cooperation, and widely build consensus. Encourage and support people's courts along the corridor to host training seminars for foreign judges, to deepen the understanding and trust of neighboring countries and regions in China's judiciary. Actively promote the achievements in building a rule-of-law China, explain China's foreign-related judicial concepts, propositions, and successful practices, and enhance the international influence of China's judiciary.

April 27, 2025
